content: Yooseefey gelidi Gibxe kawos, «Ta aawaynne ta ishati ba dorsatara, ba miizatara baas dizaaz ubbaa ekkidi Kanaane biittafe yiidi, ha7i Geeseme biittan deettes» gi yootides.
Izi ba ishatappe ichchashata dooridi kawoza sinth aaththides.
Kawoy he ishata, «Intte oosoy aazee?» gi oychchiin istti kawozas, «Nuni ne aylleti nu aawataththo dorsa heemmoos» gi yootida.

Qasse istti izas, «Kanaane biittan koshay darida gishshas nuus ne aylleta mehetas miza miishshi aykkoka baynda gishshas, nuni hayssan imaththateththan daana yidos; shoobbe nuna ne aylleta Geesemen woththarkkii!» gida.
Kawoy Yooseefe, «Ne aawaynne ne ishati neekko yida.

Histtiin Gibxe derey ne kushen dees gidennee; ha biittan ubbaafe aadhdhidi lo7izason ne aawaanne ne ishata woththa; istti Geeseme biittan detto. Istta giddofe dumma erateththi dizayta ne erizaa gidikko heyta ta meheta bolla shuuma» gides.
Hessafe guye Yooseefey ba aawaa Yaaqoobe gelththidi kawo sinth aaththides. Yaaqoobey Gibxe kawo anjjides.
Kawoykka Yaaqoobe, «Nees aappun layththee?» gi oychchides.
Yaaqoobey kawozas, «Tani yuuya yuuya deyida layththay 130; ta layththay beni ta aawati yuuyi yuuyi deyida layththatappe guuththanne metoy darida layththa» gides.
Hessafe guye Yaaqoobey kawoza anjjidi iza sinththafe kare kezides.
Yooseefey ba aawaanne ba ishata Gibxe biittan woththides; kawoy azazida mala Gibxe biittan Eraamise achchan diza ubbasoppe aadhdhidi lo7iza gade isttas immides.
Yooseefey qasse ba aawaas, ba ishatassinne ba aawa soo asaa ubbaas istta nayta qooda mala kath immides.
Gibxe Kosha Minoteth
Gidikkoka koshay darida gishshas biitta ubbaa bolla kaththi dhaydes. He koshaan Gibxe dereynne Kanaane derey nam7ayka qohettida.
Yooseefey Gibxe kath bayzidi Gibxeninne Kanaane biittan diza miish ubbaa shiishshidi Gibxe kawo keeth gelththides.
Gibxe miishshaynne Kanaane miishshay ubbay wuriin Gibxe asay wuri Yooseefekko yiidi iza, «Nuus kath imma; nu miishshay wurida gishshas nuni ne dishin ays hayqqizonii?» gida.
Histtiin Yooseefey isttas, «Intte mehe ekki yiite; intte miishshay wuridaa gidikko tani kath inttes mehera laammana» gides.
Hessa gishshas istti ba mehe Yooseefes ehiin Yooseefey istta para, dorsa, deyshe, miizinne hare kaththara laammides; izi he layth istta mehe ubbaara kath laammi laammi mizi shaachchides.

He layththay wuriin nam7anththo layththan istti izakko yiidi izas, «Nuni nu godaappe qottiza miishshi deenna; nu miishshay wurides; nuus diza mehekka ubbaa nees sheedhdhidos; nu godaas nees nunateththafenne nu gadeppe attiin nu immana miishshi haray deenna.

Ne dishin nu ays hayqqizonii? Nu gadeykka ays dhayzee? Nunakka nu gadezakka kaththara laamma; nuni kawos aylletana; nu gadeykka izas gido; nuni hayqqontta de7on daana malanne nu gadeykka oxxontta mala zereth nuus imma» gida.
Yooseefey Gibxe biitta ubbaa kawos shammides. Gibxeti wuri koshay minnida gishshas ba gadeza bayziin gadezi kawos gidides.
Yooseefey Gibxe asa ubbaa ha gaxappe doommidi he gaxa gakkanaas kawos aylle kessides.
Gidikkoka kawoy qeesetas kath immiza gishshas qeeseta gade shammibeenna. Hessa gishshas qeeseti ba gade bayzibeettenna.
Yooseefey asaa, «Histtiin hach tani inttenanne intte gade kawos shammida gishshas zereth ekkidi intte gaden gaden zerite.

Gido attiin kath maxi gelththiza wode kaththaafe ichchashu kusheppe issi kushe kawos immite. Ichchash kusheppe attida oyddu kushezi intte gades zereth, intteso asaassinne intte naytas quma gido» gides.
Histtiin istti, «Neni nuna ashshadasa! Nu godaa sinththan nuni nashettidaa gidikko nu kawos aylle gidana» gida.

Hessa gishshas Yooseefey Gibxe biittan kaxxida kaththaas ichchash kusheppe issi kushe kawos immizayssi woga gidana mala ooththides. He wogazikka hach gakkanaas eqqi dees. Kawos gidontta gadey qeeseta gade xalla.
Isra7eeleti Gibxe biittan Geeseme geetettizason uttida; istti heen aqota demmida; istti yelettidanne daro corattida.
Yaaqoobey Gibxe biittan 17 layth de7ides. Yaaqoobey de7ida layththay issi xeetanne oyddu tammanne laappuna.

Yaaqoobes hayqo wodey matiin ba naa Yooseefe xeygisidi, «Tani ne sinththan sabettidaa gidikko ne kushe ta gulbate bolla woththada neni taas kiyattanaassinne ammanettanaas ane caaqqa. Tana Gibxen moogoppa.
Gido attiin tani ta aawatan gaaggiza wode tana Gibxeppe efada istti moogettidason mooga» gides. Histtiin Yooseefey, «Tani nena neni gida mala ooththana» gides.
Yaaqoobey iza, «Ane taas caaqqa» gides. Yooseefeykka izas caaqqides; hessafe guye Yaaqoobey ba hiixan gufannidi Xoossas goynnides.
